{{Top|leg}}
'''Moffice's Grocers''' was a grocery in an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulation]]. [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]], while acting as [[Gold Eight/Legends|Gold Eight]], ran into the side of a building bearing the words "Welcome to Moffice's Grocers", attempting to artificially lower her [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] scores, in an attempt to be sent to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Atton Repness|Repness's]] remedial squadron.
